registry_metadata.description: Controlled vocabulary of supranational bodies with enforcement or binding executive authority, registered as valid values for leg_jurisdiction.supra in LEG-origin events. Admission criterion: direct enforcement authority or binding decision-making power over regulated entities or member states.

entries.name: European Union
entries.enforcement_basis: TFEU — ECJ enforcement, infringement proceedings, direct effect, treaty supremacy

entries.name: European Banking Authority
entries.enforcement_basis: EU Regulation 1093/2010 — binding technical standards, breach-of-Union-law investigations

entries.name: European Securities and Markets Authority
entries.enforcement_basis: EU Regulation 1095/2010 — direct supervisory authority over CRAs, trade repositories, CCPs

entries.name: European Central Bank
entries.enforcement_basis: TEU/TFEU, SSM Regulation (EU 1024/2013) — monetary policy, direct banking supervision

entries.name: United Nations Security Council
entries.enforcement_basis: UN Charter Chapter VII — mandatory measures, override of domestic law, enforcement authorization
entries.notes: Chapter VII resolutions are binding on all 193 UN member states and override domestic law. Primary use case: UNSC sanctions (reason_code=SA triggers LEG-007 BL force in v1.5.1; was LEG-008 in v1.5).

entries.name: Financial Action Task Force
entries.enforcement_basis: FATF Mandate — High-Risk Jurisdictions (blacklist) and Increased Monitoring (greylist) listings create systemic market exclusion
entries.notes: Not a treaty body. Enforcement through systemic exclusion. Blacklist: BL force (reason_code=SA + LEG-007 in v1.5.1; was LEG-008 in v1.5). Greylist: HL only.

entries.name: International Criminal Court
entries.enforcement_basis: Rome Statute (1998) — binding arrest warrants, surrender obligations on State Parties
entries.notes: Jurisdiction over individuals, not entities. Relevant to asset freezing in ICC proceedings. A final ICC warrant supports leg_subtype=JUD.

entries.name: International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes
entries.enforcement_basis: ICSID Convention Art. 54 — final awards binding and enforceable as final domestic court judgments in all contracting states
entries.notes: Most enforceable form of international investment arbitration. A final ICSID award is treated as JUD-equivalent for control derivation purposes.
